rooms.rationale: I chose a vivid yellow for the walls and floor, lit at a very bright level, on smooth bare concrete. Together the colour, the light and the surface are what carry excited in a room this size.
I chose a faint blue-green for the walls and floor, lit at a dim level, on rough bare concrete. Together the colour, the light and the surface are what carry tense in a room this size.
